summary: Variable-level encryption keeps files legible and allows mixing plaintext and encrypted values, but encrypted variables cannot be rekeyed and only variables (not tasks) can be encrypted this way.
questions: Can I rekey variables encrypted with encrypt_string?
What are the downsides of encrypting individual variables?
Can I mix encrypted and plaintext variables in one file?

answer_card.title: Pros and cons of variable-level encryption
answer_card.answer_md:
**Pros**: files stay readable, and you can mix plaintext and encrypted variables, even inline in a play or role.

**Cons**: password rotation is harder because you **cannot rekey** encrypted variables, and it only works for variables. To encrypt tasks or other content, encrypt the whole file.
